notes:
Gwiriko, additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Pages: Gwiriko, Bobo-Dioulasso (Gwiriko Empire, Famagan Ouattara did not load).

The two pages differ on the first years: the Gwiriko page has the first kingdom in the Mouhoun bend about 1714; the Bobo-Dioulasso page has Famagan and Seku's sons conquering Sia in the late 1730s. The 1740 independence is the infobox's. The kong-empire dossier of this batch has no Gwiriko event: Kong's ledger should record the loss of Tiefo, Dafin and Bwamu to Gwiriko about 1740 (infobox, Gwiriko page). After 1839 the page says the state collapsed, but it names the Watara of Bobo-Dioulasso (Kongondinn, Yemori, Guimbe Ouattara) fighting Kenedougou into the 1890s and rebelling Bobo allying with Samori in 1896; the shape is held until 1897. The French capture of Sia on 25 September 1897 sets the end; the page's end of the title is 1909-15. Month 9 is from the Bobo-Dioulasso page.
